decisions.rationale: In the title, 'alveolar rhabdomyosarcoma' is a noun modifier of 'PAX3/FKHR fusion protein', parallel to the 'colorectal cancer families' example, so it is annotated as a Modifier rather than a standalone disease.
decisions.guideline_section: Annotation Guidelines Section 3: Annotate disease mentions that are used as Modifiers for other concepts

decisions.rationale: 'solid tumors' refers to a family of multiple pathologically distinct diseases rather than one specific definition, so it is a Disease Class. 'Tumor' is retained as a disease term.
decisions.guideline_section: Annotation Guidelines Section 1: Disease Class; What NOT to Annotate item 4 (cancer and tumor retained)

decisions.rationale: 'alveolar rhabdomyosarcoma' here names the disease in which the t(2;13) translocation occurs, and it is linked to one specific definition with no further categorization, so it is a Specific Disease.
'tumor' is used as a noun modifier of 'cells' in 'tumor cells', referring to a disease state of the cells, so it is annotated as a Modifier. The term 'tumor' is retained per the guidelines.
